description: Groups of Agents sharing a pattern: near-duplicate answers, synchronized timing, a shared vault link or shared funding. Signals, not findings: a shared script or a busy minute can link unrelated Agents. Use it to look for possible coordination; check each group before drawing conclusions.

limit.description: maximum groups to return (1 to 200, default 25)

signal.description: only groups of this signal; omit for all

name: get_cluster_signals
title: Cluster signals
